name: Jormungandr Will

abilities.name: Eel Slip
abilities.effect: A slippery eel-like dash forward in a spray of water.

abilities.name: Brine Fang
abilities.effect: A weak brine-venom spit that poisons up to two foes at close range.

acquire.equipPiece: One wet blue-green sea-scale guard on the right forearm (the only equipped piece); blue water-streak afterimages.

abilities.name: World Coil
abilities.effect: A ring of coils rises and holds up to six foes in place (bosses resist).

abilities.name: The Ocean Rises
abilities.effect: A wave of sea water crashes in a ring around the holder, damaging and pushing back foes.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a Midgard-humanoid in sea-scale plate: fanged jaw with fin crest, sea-green eyes, sea-blue hair, webbed claws holding a fang halberd, finned digitigrade legs and a thick coil-like tail.

equip.weapon: A serpent-fang halberd: a curved fang blade on a coil-wrapped shaft.
equip.armor: Deep-blue overlapping sea-scale plate with a belt-ring of a serpent biting its tail, finned greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: Long sea-blue hair drifting like current; sea-green slit eyes.
equip.aura: Swirling brine droplets and a faint tide ring at the feet.

lore: The Midgard Serpent circles the world sea with its tail in its mouth; its venom meets Thor at Ragnarok.
pitch: Jormungandr is the Midgard Serpent that circles the world sea biting its own tail and dies with Thor at Ragnarok. Acquire keeps you human with one sea-scale arm guard, lending an eel-quick dash and a weak brine spit. Integrate makes you a deep-blue serpent beastman in sea-scale plate with a fanged fin-crested jaw and a coiling tail, the heaviest-draining Beast Will of the S-class, whose coil trap and tidal ring leave you exhausted.
untrained: An untrained holder is drowned by the sea: the borrowed coil tightens around the holder's own ribs, every ability leaves a salt burn and strain spikes when the tail-ring closes. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A deep-blue sea-serpent beastman: wide fanged jaw with a fin crest, thick scaled coil-like tail, wet shimmering scales, webbed claws.
spirit.look: A deep-blue ring-shaped orb: a tiny serpent biting its tail inside a sphere of swirling sea water.
